snippet.title: [OLD 1080p] Akuma's Bloodrain - Trailer
snippet.description:
Be prepared to face hordes of akumas/yokais that are attacking and creating caos in a small japanese village. You're the only ninja alive that can protect this village from the eternal pain.

You must slaughter all enemies without mercy before the time is up, the quicker and bloodier the better.

Akuma's Bloodrain is a fast-paced boomer shooter inspired by the classics DOOM and Shadow Warrior, where you have to use your weapons and ninja reflexes in the maximum level to beat the waves of akumas.

Check it out on steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3692360/Akumas_Bloodrain/
